model_annotation:
Both plots share a similar structure with dual y-axes and an x-axis representing time. The x-axis in both plots spans from 1995 to approximately 2021, with tick labels at 5-year intervals (1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020) on a linear scale. The left y-axis in both plots is labeled "IWF Fiskalindex" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 2.5 in the left plot and from approximately -5 to 2 in the right plot, with tick intervals of 0.5. The right y-axis in the left plot is labeled "Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat" ranging from 60 to 120, while in the right plot it is labeled "Schuldenquote Zentralstaat" ranging from 30 to 70, both on linear scales.

In the left plot, a blue solid line begins near 0 around 1995, remains relatively low (below 0.2) through 2002, then rises to approximately 0.5 around 2005, dips back to around 0.3 near 2007, increases again to roughly 1.0 by 2010, fluctuates between approximately 0.6 and 0.8 from 2012 to 2018, and then declines to around 0.3 by 2020. A purple/dark magenta solid line starts near 0.05 in 1995, gradually increases through the period, reaching approximately 0.5 around 2005, about 1.0 by 2010, approximately 1.5 by 2015, and rises to roughly 2.0 by 2020. Blue triangle markers are scattered at higher values, appearing at approximately 0.9 from 1995 to around 2003, then jumping to about 1.3 around 2004–2006, and rising to approximately 2.3 from around 2010 onward. Red/pink triangle markers begin near 0.1 in 1995, gradually increase to about 0.5 by 2005, reach approximately 1.0 by 2010, and rise to about 1.75 by 2020.

In the right plot, a blue solid line starts near 0 in 1995, fluctuates around 0 to -0.1 through approximately 2003, then rises sharply to about 1.0 by 2008–2009, remains near 0.8–1.0 until around 2015, and then declines to approximately -0.2 by 2020. A purple/dark magenta solid line begins near approximately 0.1 in 1995, stays relatively flat near 0 to 0.2 through 2005, then increases to about 0.5 by 2010, continues rising to approximately 0.8 by 2015, and reaches roughly 1.0 by 2020, with a steeper increase after 2018 to about 2.4. Blue triangle markers appear at approximately 0.9 from 1995 to around 2003, increase to about 1.0–1.3 around 2005–2008, and rise to approximately 2.3 from around 2015 onward. Red/pink triangle markers remain relatively low, scattered between approximately -0.2 and 0.2 from 1995 through 2005, then gradually increase to about 0.5–0.7 by 2015–2020.
